description:
You are working in Eclipse IDE with a Java project called 'notification-system' that is located in the Eclipse workspace at /home/ga/eclipse-workspace/notification-system.

The project contains two service classes that share significant duplicated code:
- EmailNotificationService.java (in package com.acme.notify)
- SMSNotificationService.java (in package com.acme.notify)

Both classes have the following IDENTICAL fields and methods that should be extracted into a common abstract superclass:

Shared Fields:
- private String serviceName
- private boolean enabled
- private int maxRetries

Shared Methods:
- public boolean isEnabled()
- public void setEnabled(boolean enabled)
- public String getServiceName()
- public int getMaxRetries()
- public void setMaxRetries(int maxRetries)
- protected boolean validateRecipient(String recipient)
- protected NotificationResult createFailureResult(String reason)

Your task:
1. If the project is not yet visible in Eclipse's Package Explorer, import it (File > Import > Existing Maven Projects, browse to /home/ga/eclipse-workspace/notification-system)
2. Open EmailNotificationService.java
3. Use Eclipse's Refactor > Extract Superclass refactoring to create a new abstract class named 'AbstractNotificationService' in the same package (com.acme.notify)
4. Select all the shared fields and methods listed above to be pulled up into the new superclass
5. After the refactoring completes for EmailNotificationService, open SMSNotificationService.java
6. Update SMSNotificationService to also extend AbstractNotificationService
7. Remove the duplicated fields and methods from SMSNotificationService (the ones now inherited from AbstractNotificationService)
8. Make sure constructors in both subclasses properly initialize the inherited fields (you may need to add a constructor to the superclass or use super calls)
9. Build the project (Ctrl+B or Project > Build) and verify there are no compilation errors
10. Run the existing test class NotificationServiceTest (right-click > Run As > JUnit Test) and verify all tests pass

IMPORTANT: The final state must have:
- AbstractNotificationService.java in src/main/java/com/acme/notify/ containing the 3 shared fields and 7 shared methods
- EmailNotificationService extending AbstractNotificationService with NO duplicated common members
- SMSNotificationService extending AbstractNotificationService with NO duplicated common members
- All 20+ existing unit tests still passing
